questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Chemical Reactions and Equations. which observation most directly indicates formation of a gas when zinc reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid?
questions.explanation: Zinc reacts with dilute HCl to release hydrogen gas, seen as effervescence.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Chemical Reactions and Equations. in the reaction CuO + H2 → Cu + H2O, which substance is reduced?
questions.explanation: CuO loses oxygen and is reduced to copper.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Acids, Bases and Salts. which indicator turns red in an acidic solution and blue in a basic solution?
questions.explanation: Litmus is red in acid and blue in base.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Acids, Bases and Salts. a solution has pH 3. Its hydrogen ion concentration compared with pH 5 is:
questions.explanation: Each pH unit represents a tenfold change; two units means 100 times.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Metals and Non-metals. which metal is commonly stored under kerosene because it reacts vigorously with air and water?
questions.explanation: Sodium is highly reactive and is stored under kerosene to prevent contact with air/moisture.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Metals and Non-metals. which method is generally used to extract a highly reactive metal such as sodium from its compound?
questions.explanation: Highly reactive metals are obtained by electrolytic reduction of molten compounds.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Carbon and Its Compounds. the functional group present in ethanol is:
questions.explanation: Ethanol is an alcohol containing the hydroxyl group.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Carbon and Its Compounds. which pair represents a homologous series?
questions.explanation: Successive members of an alkane series differ by –CH2–.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Life Processes. which part of the nephron filters blood under pressure?
questions.explanation: The glomerulus filters blood into Bowman’s capsule.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Life Processes. in humans, most absorption of digested food occurs in the:
questions.explanation: The small intestine has villi that provide a large absorptive surface.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Control and Coordination. which part of the brain maintains posture and balance?
questions.explanation: The cerebellum coordinates muscular activity, posture and balance.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Control and Coordination. a plant shoot bends towards light because auxin:

options.A: Accumulates on illuminated side and stops growth
options.B: Accumulates on shaded side and promotes elongation

questions.explanation: Auxin promotes greater cell elongation on the shaded side, bending the shoot towards light.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing How Do Organisms Reproduce?. which process produces genetically identical offspring in Amoeba?
questions.explanation: Amoeba commonly reproduces asexually by binary fission.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Heredity. in a cross Tt × Tt, where T is dominant, what fraction of offspring is expected to be tt?
questions.explanation: The genotype ratio is 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt, so one-fourth are tt.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: January challenge: During new-year competency practice, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Light – Reflection and Refraction. an object is placed beyond 2F of a convex lens. The image is:
questions.explanation: For an object beyond 2F, a convex lens forms a real, inverted, diminished image between F and 2F.
